title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on Numbers 24: Balaam's third and fourth parables, the star out of Jacob, and his words about Amalek, the Kenite and Kittim.

questions.text: What did Balaam do differently this time when he saw that it pleased Yahweh to bless Israel?
questions.explanation: He did not go to use divination as at the other times, but set his face toward the wilderness.

answers.text: He set his face toward the wilderness without divination
He went home to Aram without speaking a word
He asked Balak for more silver and gold first
He fasted alone for three days on the mountain

questions.text: What came on Balaam when he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes?
questions.explanation: Balaam lifted up his eyes, saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes, and the Spirit of God came on him.

questions.text: Which words did Balaam use to praise Israel's tents?
questions.explanation: Balaam said, "How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!"

questions.text: Who did Balaam say Israel's king would be higher than?
questions.explanation: Balaam said, "His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted."

questions.text: What did Balaam say about everyone who blesses Israel?
questions.explanation: Balaam said, "Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed."

answers.text: They will live long in the land

questions.text: What did Balak do when his anger burned against Balaam?
questions.explanation: Balak's anger burned against Balaam and he struck his hands together, saying Balaam had blessed his enemies these three times.

answers.text: He threw dust on his head

questions.text: What did Balaam see coming out of Jacob in his vision of what was "not near"?
questions.explanation: Balaam said, "A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel."

questions.text: What did Balaam say about Amalek?
questions.explanation: He said, "Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction."

answers.text: It would become Israel's servant for all generations
It would be blessed above all the nations of the earth
It was the first of the nations, but would come to destruction
It would join with Israel to fight against Moab

questions.text: Where did Balaam say the Kenite's nest was set?
questions.explanation: Looking at the Kenite, Balaam said, "Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock."

questions.text: Where did Balaam say ships would come from?
questions.explanation: Balaam said, "But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber."
